[b]January 4, 2028: A Speech to the Nation[/b]

My dear friends, Rosenmarkke won the war last year. The war against the vile continentalist powers who seek the destruction of our beautiful Rosenmarkke was won. With grit and strength, through our economic genius we secured the largest increase in gross domestic product since 1934, we slimmed down our armed forces, we increased school choice and social programs. We won so much last year, and were going to keep winning this year, against the powers of the continent, the doubters, the haters. 

In 2028 we will found a central bank, the biggest central bank on the globe, our gold reserves will be safe and secure because the glory of Rosenmarkke shall never fade. In 2028 I also will personally ensure that we formally establish and begin with all due speed a national space program, which will see our enemies tremble in awe for the glory of Rosenmarkke shall reach the stars, like our founders prophesied in 1643. Furthermore we shall expand our borders beyond the 5th and 6th estates in order to secure and defend Eastern Elseyr from our enemies. There will be all of this and so much more, glory to Rosenmarkke.

-Polenne Strømm

[b]January 4, 2028: Needed Renovations[/b]

The National State House or National Peoples Palace or simply The Manor has been long in need of modernisation and major renovations to improve its aesthetic appeal. For decades the assembly waffled about the matter, consistently forcing the triumvirate to utilise private contractors and donations for renovations.

A recent State Committee for the Triumviral Manor meeting has quietly confirmed that in November of 2027 the chief consul requested permission to add a pergola to the properties rear patio to replace the aging 1940s structure. The SCTM formally approved $200 for the pergola but as of January 4 approved another $100 from the management budget of $2.3 Million.

In a public speech to supporters held after her national address Strømm is cited: Today we secured a great victory against the elites of Tharkønn, I am happy to announce that a glorious pergola shall be added to the state patio for only $300, paid and funded by the pockets of the assembly. The Pergola will be a shiny new and very strong pergola, indeed, it shall outshine the pergolas of our enemies, glory to Rosenmarkke.
